entry_state: Fair-value transition is calculated per admitted group before aggregation;pooling the two sign cases understates liabilities20. Transition recovery can use the C20A timing exception but remains a component within a separately measured held asset. Munich Re's transition bridge preserves rounded endpoints,population scopes and dated entity parameters. Chapter12 ends336 with event,component and unresolved-method requirements. It supplies finite insurance cases and source distinctions,not executed transition,general VFA,actuarial validation or domain readiness. Chapter13 starts next at337.
exit_state: The reference stack is a convenience choice,with committed books in one transactional store and analytical files derived. Persistent identities,versions and conditional results survive aggregation. Exact requests bind settings,views and expected heads;operation disposition differs from validity. Failed mass2/5 remains in the result and bounds the example mean104–116. Corrections create new views and invalidate candidate-set dependencies without rewriting history. Durability,migration and restart have observable obligations requiring runtime tests. Plugin declarations expose material inputs;solver unknown means unresolved coverage,not infeasibility.

findings.observation: The storage table has a legitimate reference role after extensive examples;its immutable identities and one-store commitment rule preserve the earlier accounting distinctions.
Request/result envelopes distinguish retained submission,validated request,operation disposition and commit observation. The failed-mass calculation prevents success-only renormalization.
Corrections retain old views and candidate-set dependencies. Format migration is distinguished from a changed model,and the text explicitly requires crash/reopen evidence beyond a chosen database.
